scripts.build:npm: npm run build -w @laczynski/datagrid && npm run build -w @laczynski/datagrid-primeng && npm run build -w @laczynski/datagrid-ui && npm run build -w @laczynski/datagrid-spartan
scripts.build:frontend: npm run build:npm && npm run build -w datagrid-showcase-ui
scripts.build:all: npm run build:backend && npm run build:frontend
scripts.start:frontend: npm run build:npm && node scripts/clear-showcase-cache.mjs && npm run start -w datagrid-showcase-ui
scripts.start:all: npm run build:npm && node scripts/clear-showcase-cache.mjs && concurrently -n frontend,backend -c cyan,green "npm run start -w datagrid-showcase-ui" "npm run start:backend"
scripts.dev:frontend: npm run build:npm && node scripts/clear-showcase-cache.mjs && concurrently -k -n core,primeng,ui,spartan,showcase -c blue,magenta,yellow,green,cyan "npm run watch:core" "npm run watch:primeng" "npm run watch:ui" "npm run watch:spartan" "npm run start -w datagrid-showcase-ui"
scripts.test:npm: npm run build:npm && npm run build:cli && npm run test -w @laczynski/datagrid && npm run test -w @laczynski/datagrid-primeng && npm run test -w @laczynski/datagrid-ui && npm run test -w @laczynski/datagrid-spartan && npm run test -w @laczynski/datagrid-cli
scripts.test:all: npm run test:backend && npm run test:npm
scripts.pack:npm: npm run build:npm && node -e "require('fs').mkdirSync('artifacts/npm',{recursive:true})" && npm pack -w @laczynski/datagrid --pack-destination artifacts/npm && node scripts/pack-primeng.mjs && node scripts/pack-ui.mjs && node scripts/pack-spartan.mjs && npm pack -w @laczynski/datagrid-cli --pack-destination artifacts/npm
scripts.publish:npm: npm run build:npm && npm run build:cli && npm publish -w @laczynski/datagrid --access public --tag preview && npm publish src/npm/packages/primeng/dist --access public --tag preview && npm publish src/npm/packages/ui/dist --access public --tag preview && npm publish src/npm/packages/spartan/dist --access public --tag preview && npm publish -w @laczynski/datagrid-cli --access public --tag preview
